title: MMMU: A Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI
reasoning: The paper includes an 'Ethical Considerations' section (H.6 on page 116) that focuses on data collection ethics (copyright and privacy) rather than evaluating or benchmarking language models for their understanding or reasoning about religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of the benchmark itself. The benchmark's focus is on college-level subject knowledge and general reasoning abilities.
